packages.label: אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּקְבוּרַת צַדִּיקִים
packages.label_en: Eretz Yisrael and the Burial of Tzaddikim
packages.reason: The torah identifies the burial place of true tzaddikim with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael itself ('מקום גניזתם הוא קדוש בקדושת ארץ ישראל ממש'), and further identifies Eretz Yisrael as a tikkun for pgam habrit ('ארץ ישראל הוא תיקון גדול לפגם הברית'). Both are bechina-style identifications using 'הוא' language — shared essential nature, not cause-and-effect. All three concepts cluster around the kedusha of Eretz Yisrael.
merge_notes: All three concepts form a single connected component via bechina identifications in the source text. No merging of separate components was needed.
packages.good_evil_mirror: No evil mirror is present in this very short teaching. The torah discusses only the positive dimension — the holiness of the tzaddik's grave and Eretz Yisrael.
